definitions.zh: vt. 供给...经费, 负担经费

definitions.en: n. the management of money and credit and banking and investments
definitions.zh: vi. 筹措资金

examples.en: He works in finance.
examples.zh: 他在金融领域工作。

examples.en: They will finance the project.
examples.zh: 他们将资助这个项目。

definitions.en: n. a path over which electrical signals can pass
definitions.zh: n. 海峡, 航道, 频道

definitions.en: n. a passage for water (or other fluids) to flow through
definitions.zh: vt. 引导, 在...上挖沟, 形成河道

definitions.en: n. a deep and relatively narrow body of water (as in a river or a harbor or a strait linking two larger bodies) that allows the best passage for vessels
definitions.zh: [计] 信道, 通道

examples.en: Change the TV channel, please.
examples.zh: 请换电视频道。

examples.en: Water flows through the channel.
examples.zh: 水流过这条水道。

definitions.en: n. preceding in time
definitions.zh: n. 优先权, 优先
[计] 优先级

examples.en: Safety is our top priority.
examples.zh: 安全是我们的首要任务。

examples.en: Finish this task as a priority.
examples.zh: 优先完成这项任务。

definitions.en: v. give sanction to
definitions.zh: vt. 赞同, 核准, 为...提供证据

definitions.en: v. judge to be right or commendable; think well of
definitions.zh: vi. 赞许

examples.en: The manager will approve your request.
examples.zh: 经理会批准你的请求。

examples.en: I approve of your decision.
examples.zh: 我赞同你的决定。

definitions.en: n the entire amount of income before any deductions are made
definitions.zh: n. 收入, 岁入, 税收, 税务局

definitions.en: n government income due to taxation
definitions.zh: [经] 岁入, 税收, 税务局

examples.en: The company's revenue increased this year.
examples.zh: 公司今年的收入增加了。

examples.en: Tax revenue helps build roads.
examples.zh: 税收有助于修建道路。

definitions.en: n. a vivid mental image
definitions.zh: n. 视觉, 眼光, 视力, 幻想

definitions.en: n. the perceptual experience of seeing
definitions.zh: vt. 梦见, 想象, 显示

examples.en: He has poor vision without glasses.
examples.zh: 他不戴眼镜视力很差。

examples.en: She has a clear vision for the future.
examples.zh: 她对未来有清晰的愿景。

definitions.en: n a general direction in which something tends to move
definitions.zh: n. 趋势, 倾向, 走向

definitions.en: n general line of orientation
definitions.zh: vi. 倾向, 转向

definitions.en: n a general tendency to change (as of opinion)
definitions.zh: [计] 趋势

examples.en: This fashion trend is popular now.
examples.zh: 这种时尚趋势现在很流行。

examples.en: The trend shows rising prices.
examples.zh: 趋势显示价格上涨。

definitions.en: n someone who holds shares of stock in a corporation
definitions.zh: n. 股东
[法] 股东, 股票持有人

examples.en: The shareholder attended the meeting.
examples.zh: 股东参加了会议。

examples.en: Each shareholder owns part of the company.
examples.zh: 每位股东拥有公司的一部分。

definitions.en: n. the activity of formally presenting something (as a prize or reward)
definitions.zh: n. 赠与, 描述, 介绍

definitions.en: n. a show or display; the act of presenting something to sight or view
definitions.zh: [计] 简报

examples.en: She gave a great presentation today.
examples.zh: 她今天做了一个很棒的演示。

examples.en: The presentation lasted one hour.
examples.zh: 这个演示持续了一个小时。

definitions.en: v. make an investment
definitions.zh: vt. 投资, 花费, 笼罩, 授予

definitions.en: v. furnish with power or authority; of kings or emperors
definitions.zh: vi. 投资, 利用

examples.en: I want to invest in stocks.
examples.zh: 我想投资股票。

examples.en: They invest time in learning.
examples.zh: 他们投入时间学习。

definitions.en: v. succeed in passing through, around, or over
definitions.zh: vi. 商议, 谈判, 交涉
vt. 谈妥, 转让, 处理

examples.en: We need to negotiate the price.
examples.zh: 我们需要协商价格。

examples.en: They will negotiate a new contract.
examples.zh: 他们将谈判一份新合同。

definitions.en: n. an ordered list of times at which things are planned to occur
definitions.zh: n. 时间表, 一览表, 计划表, 议事日程

definitions.en: v. plan for an activity or event
definitions.zh: vt. 预定, 编制目录, 制...表, 安排

examples.en: Check the train schedule online.
examples.zh: 在线查看火车时刻表。

examples.en: We schedule a meeting for Monday.
examples.zh: 我们安排周一的会议。

definitions.en: v. get or ask advice from
definitions.zh: vi. 商讨, 商量, 协商, 会诊

definitions.en: v. seek information from
definitions.zh: vt. 向...请教, 查阅, 考虑

examples.en: Consult a doctor if you are sick.
examples.zh: 如果你生病了，咨询医生。

examples.en: She will consult the manual first.
examples.zh: 她会先查阅手册。

definitions.en: n. the boundary line or the area immediately inside the boundary
definitions.zh: n. 页边的空白, 边缘, 界限, 余裕, 差数, 差额, 保证金

definitions.en: n. an amount beyond the minimum necessary
definitions.zh: vt. 加边于, 加旁注于

definitions.en: n. the amount of collateral a customer deposits with a broker when borrowing from the broker to buy securities
definitions.zh: [计] 页边距

examples.en: Write notes in the margin.
examples.zh: 在页边空白处写笔记。

examples.en: The profit margin is very small.
examples.zh: 利润率非常小。

definitions.en: n. a temporally organized plan for matters to be attended to
definitions.zh: pl. 议程, 日常工作事项

definitions.en: n. a list of matters to be taken up (as at a meeting)
definitions.zh: [计] 待议事件

examples.en: What is on the agenda today?
examples.zh: 今天的议程是什么？

examples.en: We have a busy agenda this week.
examples.zh: 这周我们有一个繁忙的日程。

definitions.en: n. an amount of a product
definitions.zh: n. 生产量, 投资收益

definitions.en: v. be the cause or source of
definitions.zh: vt. 出产, 给予, 让出, 放弃, 使屈服

definitions.en: v. give in, as to influence or pressure
definitions.zh: vi. 出产, 屈服, 投降, 倒塌

examples.en: The farm had a good yield this year.
examples.zh: 农场今年收成很好。

examples.en: You must yield to oncoming traffic.
examples.zh: 你必须让行迎面而来的车辆。

definitions.en: n. a recognizable kind
definitions.zh: n. 商标, 牌子, 烙印

definitions.en: n. identification mark on skin, made by burning
definitions.zh: vt. 打烙印于

examples.en: This brand of shoes is popular.
examples.zh: 这个牌子的鞋很受欢迎。

examples.en: The cow has a brand on its skin.
examples.zh: 这头牛皮肤上有一个烙印。

definitions.en: n. news that updates your information
definitions.zh: vt. 更新, 使现代化

definitions.en: v. modernize or bring up to date
definitions.zh: n. 更新

definitions.en: v. bring up to date; supply with recent information
definitions.zh: [计] 更新

examples.en: Please update the software now.
examples.zh: 请现在更新软件。

examples.en: I need an update on the project.
examples.zh: 我需要项目的最新消息。

definitions.en: v. predict in advance
definitions.zh: n. 预想, 预测, 预报
vt. 预想, 预测, 预报
[计] 趋势预测

examples.en: The weather forecast says it will rain.
examples.zh: 天气预报说会下雨。

examples.en: Economists forecast a slow growth.
examples.zh: 经济学家预测增长缓慢。

definitions.en: n. the point in time at which something must be completed
definitions.zh: n. 最后期限, 截止期限
[经] 截止日期

examples.en: The deadline is next Friday.
examples.zh: 截止日期是下周五。

examples.en: We must meet the deadline.
examples.zh: 我们必须赶上截止日期。

definitions.en: n. work that a person is expected to do in a specified time
definitions.zh: n. 工作量
[化] 工作量

examples.en: My workload is very heavy today.
examples.zh: 我今天的工作量非常大。

examples.en: She manages a large workload well.
examples.zh: 她很好地处理了大量工作。

definitions.en: n progress (or rate of progress) in work being done
definitions.zh: 工作流程

examples.en: The new software improves our workflow.
examples.zh: 新软件改进了我们的工作流程。

examples.en: We need to streamline the workflow process.
examples.zh: 我们需要简化工作流程。
